horizon_driver: Party Congress cycle (5-year) nested inside a multi-decade de-dollarization strategy; PBOC has no electoral clock and is not independent of the State Council, so its horizon is the Party's, not its own.

capabilities.meaning: maintain current fixing band and capital-account gate settings
incremental liberalization step (pilot-zone quota expansion, bilateral RMB settlement deal, gold purchase)
sharp capital-control tightening, abrupt CNY devaluation, or aggressive CIPS/gold push in response to outflow pressure

constraints.source: managed float regime, daily fixing mechanism
constraints.breaks_under: severe, sustained capital outflow pressure (precedent: 2015-16 devaluation episode)

constraints.source: State Council control; Bruegel/Merics reporting that capital-account openness remains ~16% of OECD average with explicit 'firewalls'
constraints.breaks_under: essentially does not break in the observed period; reserve-currency ambition has not yet been allowed to override control

constraints.source: PBOC is constitutionally and administratively subordinate to the State Council, not an independent central bank
constraints.breaks_under: never — this is the actor's defining structural feature, not a negotiable constraint

stated_vs_revealed.stated: PBOC's 2025 roadmap frames RMB internationalization and capital account opening as 'bold' and proceeding toward possible nationwide rollout of pilot mechanisms by 2026.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: As of 2026 China's capital account remains only about 16% as open as the OECD average (Bruegel), and Merics reporting describes the actual approach as 'limited globalisation' with monitored pilots (Greater Bay Area, Shanghai Free-Trade Zone) and explicit 'firewalls,' with full liberalization not envisaged even in the current plan.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: Internationalization rhetoric substantially outpaces capital-account reality. The gate-keeping apparatus is fully intact; pilots are testbeds for control mechanisms, not staging grounds for imminent nationwide opening.

stated_vs_revealed.stated: Official PBOC language frames reserve diversification, including gold accumulation, as measured, prudent, and gradual portfolio risk management.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: The PBOC has extended its gold-buying streak to 22 consecutive months through August 2026 — the longest run on record, beginning November 2024 — reaching roughly 2,386.6 tonnes (76.73 million troy ounces), with June 2026's addition (14.93 tonnes) its largest single-month purchase since 2023. This is a mechanically consistent, uninterrupted accumulation pattern, not an occasional rebalancing.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: The pace and consistency of gold accumulation reveal a firmer, more deliberate de-dollarization commitment than the 'prudent, gradual' framing implies — this is the most reliable hard-flow evidence in the entire dossier because it is disclosed monthly and independently verifiable.

tripwires.if: FX reserves fall by more than roughly $100bn in a quarter
tripwires.then: capital-account gates tighten further regardless of internationalization rhetoric (2015-16 precedent)

tripwires.if: the PBOC gold-buying streak breaks for 2+ consecutive months
tripwires.then: signals either reserve-adequacy concerns or a deliberate pause in the de-dollarization program — a key leading indicator to monitor

tripwires.if: a capital-account pilot zone (Greater Bay Area, Shanghai FTZ) shows net outflow above its quota
tripwires.then: the pilot is throttled or rolled back rather than expanded nationwide, contradicting the stated 2026 roadmap

what_would_change_my_mind: A genuine, unrestricted nationwide expansion of QFII/RQFII-style quotas or removal of FX conversion caps outside pilot zones would flip the read from 'control retained' to 'controlled opening real' — worth a dedicated re-check at each PBOC policy announcement window.
